name: Yaxin Hu
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong HRI/embodied-language overlap: studies contextual dialogue, visual descriptions, accessible navigation and real-world human evaluation on mobile robots. A focused language-grounding or perception/interface project is a plausible research topic, subject to a host-approved scope.

physicalEvidence.summary: CHI 2026 first-author CaBot museum field study used GPT-4o on live camera images plus semantic exhibit context and MMDetection for nearby people. Navigation was experimenter-teleoperated with LiDAR/people-detection collision avoidance, not autonomous guide following. UIST 2025 NarraGuide deployed an LLM-based narrative mobile robot in a geology museum with 20 remote users. Both papers list Hu at UW–Madison; the CHI study was in a Japanese museum. Current William & Mary hardware access was not established.

shortVisit.summary: Current homepage recruits undergraduate, master’s and PhD students for Fall 2026 and Spring/Fall 2027. This is ordinary group/degree recruitment; no explicit external short-term visitor invitation or summer 2027 offer was verified.
